guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E

guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: bright Beatles-style rock crunch with tight low end
tone.profile: bright Beatles-style rock crunch with tight low end
tone.summary: A classic Brit rock crunch tone achieved using the AC30 TB model, paired with a slight boost for punch, and kept dry with minimal reverb/delay.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic UK cabinet IR with a specific AC30-style speaker/cabinet to better match the vintage British rock tone.

proposals.expectedGain: Increased authenticity and clarity in the high end.
